Careers

Ready for Your Next Big Challenge?
Let's Talk About It

Shield-IoT is growing and we are looking for strong, highly motivated professionals to join our team. If you thrive on solving complex problems, overcoming technology limitations and getting the job done, then we would like to meet you.

Working at Shield-IoT

Shield-IoT is a VC-backed IoT cyber security Company based out of Kfar Saba Israel. We develop an end-to- end AI-based software security platform to protect any type of IoT device, application or network. Our platform is already in use by leading service providers and utilities in the domains of smart grid, connected transportation and smart city.

We believe in empowering our team members and nurturing self-motivation. At Shield-IoT, our goal is to provide each team member with the independence, tools and support they need to get the job done.

Open Positions

Security Expert

ShieldIoT, an IoT security startup, is looking for an expert in cybersecurity to take a major part in building our IoT cybersecurity product, and be the focal point for cybersecurity for the team. The ideal candidate is a professional with demonstrated knowledge of delivering technical security solutions, building security models, analyzing communication data, and identifying cyber attack patterns in such data. Candidate must have strong experience and understanding of cyber security concepts, software development knowledge, and product perspective. Job role involves interfacing with Engineering, Data Analysts, Customers, and other functional teams and individuals.

Job Requirements
Qualifications
Advantages
Job Requirements
  • Excellent research and design skills.
  • Ready to lead the security architecture, design and development of a breakthrough IoT security product.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Information Security or related major; or equivalent job experience
  • 3+ years direct Security Architecture or Senior Security Engineering in a progressive technology setting,
  • 3+ years technical Security subject matter expertise in multiple areas such as Network Security, Endpoint Security, IoT security, OT security or Cloud Security.
  • Strong hands on experience with network traffic analysis, searching for cyber attacks patterns.
  • Vast experience with security tools such: Firewalls, NGAV, EDR, SIEM, GPO, Proxy, SSO, MFA, IPS, DLP, and others.
  • Ability to lead, influence, motivate and direct a workgroup to achieve results.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Fluent English speaker.
Advantages
  • Data Science knowledge.
  • Startup experience.
  • Customer facing experience.
  • Security regulations / standards knowledge.

BE/FE Team Leader

ShieldIoT, an IoT security startup, is looking for a backend/frontend team leader to lead our Core team and develop our AI network security anomaly detection solution, leveraging unique diversified company IP. The ideal candidate is a savvy frontend and backend technology engineer, with proven management skills, looking to work in a dynamic startup environment, participate in every stage of the product development stages, solve challenging real world problems with state-of-the-art big data technologies, and frontend frameworks.

Job Requirements
Qualifications
Advantages
Job Requirements
  • Excellent engineering skills.
  • Take a leading role for a team of talented developers in a challenging environment.
  • Manage backend (Java/Spring) engineers, frontend (Angular JS) engineers and dev-ops engineers.
Qualifications
  • Proven management skills.
  • Experience in working with Linux environment.
  • Proficient in Python.
  • Strong background in math/statistics, machine/deep learning and data mining.
  • Motivated, fast learner and independent.
  • A team player, excellent communication skills.
Advantages
  • Proficient in Apache Spark / PySpark
  • Experience with ELK stack.
  • Experience working with cloud (AWS, GCP) technologies.
  • Dev-ops know how Cyber security background.
  • Startup experience.
